status: Written BEFORE any long-daily model run. Change = new version; old results stay reported.
question: On 26 years of daily COMEX copper (HG=F, Yahoo), does any model beat HAR on 5-day-ahead range-based variance, and is QLSTMT different from LSTM? Goal: a BOUNDED null (confidence intervals), option B.
data: data/daily_long/flagged/HG_F_1d.csv (6,557 rows 2000-08-30..2026-10-09). 2 roll-suspect days (2004-10-13, 2005-05-27): ret and gap set to NaN, prices kept. 3 ambiguous days only marked. 2025-2026 NOT scored (held out for one final check).
target: y_t = log(mean of daily variance rv over days t+1..t+5); univariate (copper only).

versions.gap: BACKGROUND SENSITIVITY. rv = range variance + gap_clean^2 (gap term 0 on roll-suspect days)

floor: rv <= 0 replaced by the 1st percentile of positive rv computed on 2000-2006 only (per version). Floored days are flagged. Range version: 172 zero-range days affected (about 2.6%); gap version: far fewer.
features: log rv_t, log mean rv over 5 days, log mean rv over 22 days, standardised on TRAIN rows per origin; anchor = log 5-day mean.
purge: last 5 rows of train (before val) and last 5 rows of val (before test) are dropped because 5-day forward labels would reach into the next block. Fitted once per origin, no refit in test.

models.EWMA: decay grid .90/.94/.97/.99/.995 chosen on val QLIKE
models.HARq: QLIKE-trained linear on the 3 features, ridge lambda on val  (PRIMARY BENCHMARK)
models.GARCH11_t: GARCH(1,1)-t on close-to-close returns (%), roll-suspect returns set to 0; caveat: close-to-close, calibrated for level only
models.LSTM: hidden 8, seq 5, QLIKE loss, lr .02, 10 seeds
models.QLSTMT: 4 qubits, 1 layer, hidden 8, seq 5, QLIKE loss, lr .005, 10 seeds

seeds: 10 for each network; seed-averaged level forecasts; LSTM and QLSTMT always compared at equal seed counts.
scoring: per-model scale calibrated on val; QLIKE on test rows; ratio vs HAR (primary) and vs EWMA.
tests: Diebold-Mariano on daily QLIKE differences pooled over the 3 test windows, HAC lag 10 (5-day label overlap), two-sided, alpha .05, Holm over the 5 comparisons: EWMA, GARCH, LSTM, QLSTMT vs HAR, and QLSTMT vs LSTM. Seed-level Wilcoxon is NOT used (it measures seed noise, not forecast skill) - departure from the AGENTS.md protocol, to be shown to the supervisor.
bounded_null: 95% CI of relative QLIKE difference (model vs reference). Equivalence margin +/-3%: if the whole CI lies inside it, report 'no difference larger than 3%'.
sensitivity: exclude test rows whose feature or label window touches a floored day or an ambiguous day
run with gap vs range version
stop_rule: Report and stop. No new model variants. 2025-26 is scored only in a separate final step after the above is reported.
